title: About the Album Cover Archive

      CH-4: 📻 INTEL ARCHIVE
    
    Master Credits & Info
  


The Collection & Visual Engineering
This interactive archive brings together legendary album cover artworks and design history from two primary museum and digital preservation sources:

The Cover Art Archive via Open Culture and the Internet Archive: A massive digital preservation project archiving hundreds of thousands of historical album covers from music history.
The Browse Gallery Hipgnosis Portfolio: Featuring original album cover art prints created by Storm Thorgerson and the Hipgnosis design studio for legendary artists including Pink Floyd, Led Zeppelin, Peter Gabriel, Genesis, AC/DC, and 10cc.



Interactive Features

The Grand Hi-Fi Turntable Deck: A full interactive 33 ⅓ RPM vinyl turntable with dynamic center spindle rotation, moving tonearm stylus, illuminated LCD display, and real-time needle-drop platter exploration.
Dual Contender Comparator: Filter through genres and specific songs/albums, blend covers with the DJ Sonic Crossfader, and experiment with real-time Visual FX shaders.
Showdown Arcade: A responsive Higher/Lower rank guessing game tracking consecutive win streaks.
